WITH months AS (SELECT UNNEST(ARRAY['2026-04', '2026-05', '2026-06', '2026-07', '2026-08', '2026-09']) AS month), po AS (SELECT id, CAST(DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', submitted_at) AS DATE) AS month_start FROM purchase_orders WHERE submitted_at >= '2026-04-01' AND submitted_at < '2026-10-01'), boxes AS (SELECT po.month_start, SUM(i.quantity) AS boxes FROM po JOIN purchase_order_items AS i ON i.po_id = po.id GROUP BY po.month_start), amounts AS (SELECT po.month_start, SUM(o.total_amount) AS amount FROM po JOIN purchase_orders AS o ON o.id = po.id GROUP BY po.month_start) SELECT m.month, COALESCE(b.boxes, 0) AS boxes, COALESCE(a.amount, 0) AS amount FROM months AS m LEFT JOIN boxes AS b ON b.month_start = CAST((m.month || '-01') AS DATE) LEFT JOIN amounts AS a ON a.month_start = CAST((m.month || '-01') AS DATE) ORDER BY m.month LIMIT 100

WITH po AS (SELECT id, total_amount FROM purchase_orders WHERE submitted_at >= '2026-09-01' AND submitted_at < '2026-10-01'), po_amt AS (SELECT SUM(total_amount) AS purchase_amount, COUNT(*) AS po_count FROM po), po_qty AS (SELECT SUM(i.quantity) AS total_quantity FROM purchase_order_items AS i JOIN po ON po.id = i.po_id), targets AS (SELECT SUM(CAST((c.annual_sales_target ->> 'amount') AS DECIMAL)) AS annual_target_total FROM contracts AS c WHERE c.id IN (SELECT c2.id FROM contracts AS c2 JOIN purchase_orders AS p ON p.brand_id = c2.brand_id AND p.partnership_id = c2.partnership_id WHERE p.id IN (SELECT id FROM po))) SELECT po_amt.purchase_amount, po_qty.total_quantity, targets.annual_target_total, po_amt.purchase_amount / NULLIF(targets.annual_target_total, 0) AS purchase_to_target_ratio FROM po_amt, po_qty, targets LIMIT 100
